title: WaterColor "Wisteria Blue" 75 South Wisteria Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $25 per day**- 5 adult bikes provided- 2 Primary suites- Outdoor fireplaces- Smart TVs throughout the whole house- Hardwood floors- This property comes with 2 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Escape for 30A fun at Wisteria Blue, a lovely 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom WaterColor home that sleeps 12 guests near Seagrove Beach. Savor sunny days, splashing and relaxing in the private pool, and quiet evenings beside the outdoor fireplace. Known for its resort-style amenities, WaterColor is the ultimate beach destination, boasting multiple community pools, events, walking paths, beach access, and even a lazy river!A pleasant front porch, complete with a porch swing and 2 rocking chairs, paints a picturesque scene as guests arrive at this 2-story home. Beneath the carport, the front door leads into a well-equipped entry with cubbies for storing beach bags and more. The spacious laundry room adds convenience and provides extra space for beach toys. Multi-toned hardwood floors and white shiplap walls stretch throughout the open great room, creating a beautiful, inviting setting. Curl up on the soft sofa and 2 colorful armchairs for a family movie night. Premium appliances, including a Wolf stove, await in the chef’s kitchen. Come together for drinks at the center island featuring 4 rotating bar stools—the adjacent wet bar features a Keurig and wine cooler for tasty refreshments. A stunning oil painting of Western Lake accentuates the dining space, which seats 10, or guests can wander onto the screened side porch to enjoy an fresh air. The shimmering pool, with a sun shelf and basketball hoop, is perfect for fun in the water, while the 2 neighboring loungers offer serene sunbathing. Envision slow-paced evenings enjoying the cozy patio’s outdoor fireplace, comfy seating, and TV. At bedtime, a peaceful haven awaits in the primary bedroom, boasting a king bed and private bathroom.Upstairs, discover another primary bedroom featuring a king bed and a private bathroom. There’s also a guest bedroom with 1 king bed, a guest bedroom with 1 queen bed and 1 twin bed, and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.Exceptional amenities and WaterColor charm make Wisteria Blue a delightful base for experiencing Iconic 30A. With 2 dedicated parking spots and 5 complimentary adult bikes, exploring is easy. For beach access, choose between the WaterColor Beach Club or the access on Goldenrod Circle past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.*LSV is not for guest use.* Pool waterfall feature and jets are available upon request
